review: Independent agent engineering review, not AP practitioner sign-off
source: Frozen AP contract plus literal fixture arithmetic, independent of implementation return values or prior PASS reports
scheduling: UTC date eligibility must not advance because retry timestamp is overdue
A future command must not starve an eligible command
Cancellation before possible send releases every reservation; reschedule creates a different snapshot and needs fresh human authorization
Possible send retains original command, key, schedule, first attempt, and reservations
runAtomicity: A stale last member must roll back all new preparations and reservations
A cancelled last member must roll back authorization of earlier members
A possible send in the last member must roll back cancellation of earlier members
qbo: Only current authenticated approved recognition may become a Bill
Partial or credit-bearing local settlement is explicitly unsupported and rejected; no invented full settlement
Same identity after response loss or process restart must never create another POST or request ID
Unknown lookup with no match stays unknown; changed/duplicate economics needs review
External SyncToken or linked Bill mutation prevents a new BillPayment
Approval change during mapping lookup prevents first POST
Mapping change cannot rewrite an existing operation
Concurrent workers serialize on the private journal
State is session-bound, exact-realm and one-use; concurrent callbacks exchange once
Ambiguous refresh permanently blocks old-token reuse pending reauthorization
Private file symlinks and broad permissions cannot be read as credentials
An externally normalized economic mismatch cannot be recorded as success
